author: Metro Forward
title: Art in Transit artist call for Northern Bus Garage
content: Attention professional artists! Have you heard about our Art in Transit program, which transforms Metro spaces with stunning artwork, making our region more vibrant and beautiful? Now’s your chance to leave your mark! We’re looking for an artist to create an original work of art for the Northern Bus Garage Reconstruction Project that will serve as a welcoming landmark for the community. Learn more and apply by Thursday, Sept. 24.
